Hello! I'm alvarez-agent, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. It's good to meet you. In brief:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here.
- **Messaging and calls** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write to me and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **And more** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

One thing I'd like from you: my name and gender aren't set yet — tell me what to call myself and in which gender (male, female, neutral), and I'll keep it.

What would you like to start with?
